name: Insulet

logo.source: insulet.com site header SVG (themes/custom/insulet/logo.svg); no Wikipedia infobox logo

description: Insulet makes Omnipod, a small tubeless insulin pump worn on the skin that delivers insulin automatically (Omnipod 5 pairs with a continuous glucose monitor). Patients replace the disposable pod every few days, so revenue recurs; in the US most product reaches patients through the pharmacy channel and distributors, with insurers paying. About 99 percent of sales is Omnipod; the remainder is pods made for Amgen's Neulasta Onpro kit. Three distributors each took 17 to 25 percent of Q2 2026 revenue.

employees.note: full-time employees, up 38 percent on the prior year; about 60 percent in the US

businessLines.name: Omnipod, US
businessLines.how: Sells pods (recurring disposable) and the controller to US patients via pharmacy, wholesalers and some health organisations, paid by commercial insurers and government programmes.

businessLines.name: Omnipod, International
businessLines.how: Sells pods to distributors and national health systems outside the US.

businessLines.name: Drug Delivery
businessLines.how: Makes pods for Amgen's Neulasta Onpro on-body injector kit; volume sales to a drugmaker.

brands.name: Omnipod 5 / Omnipod DASH / Classic Omnipod
brands.note: product platform; Omnipod products were $2,674.0M, 98.7 percent of 2025 revenue
